title: aew run state
description: Schema for .aew/runs/<run-id>/state.json. Written only by scripts/state.sh; read by the orchestrator, scripts and hooks.

stage.description: Pipeline stage (run-protocol skill). qa_test_plan and plan run in parallel; while they do, stage is plan.

run_id.description: Issue number, or m-<milestone-number> for a milestone run.

issues.description: Every issue the run delivers. The PR closes all of them.

title.description: Issue title, or milestone title for a milestone run.

mode.description: single: one issue. bulk: a milestone as one run. sequential: a milestone parent run. sequential-child: one issue inside a sequential milestone.

auto.description: True when started with --auto: the plan gate is skipped. Material spec changes and irreversible actions are still gated.

branch.description: Feature branch, or null before it is created.

base_branch.description: Branch the feature branch was cut from and the PR targets. Usually the default branch; an unmerged dependency's branch for a stacked PR.

pr.description: PR number, or null before the PR exists.

spec_revision.description: Current spec version. 1 is the author's original; each recorded revision adds one.

fix_cycle.description: QA fix cycles used so far. Limited by limits.max_fix_cycles.

review_cycle.description: Review cycles used so far. Limited by limits.max_review_cycles.

history.description: One entry per stage or status transition, oldest first. Mirrored as one line each in log.md.
